card.synergies: What the sector brings the club
mayor.rating: Only what is public is known. The rest comes out by talking to him.
synergy.TUR: Bigger crowds and strong sponsors in summer; quieter in winter.
synergy.MAR: Steady sponsors and loyal fans; bad weather can postpone games.
synergy.IND: Good sponsors, but a factory closing hurts attendances and finances.
synergy.AGR: Co-operatives sponsor; attendances dip at harvest time.
synergy.UNI: Cheap young players and more scouts; crowds follow the academic year.
synergy.LOG: More away fans and better access.
synergy.PAT: Cultural tourism; stadium works take longer because of permits.
synergy.INT: Slow depopulation, very loyal fans, State and EU support, long trips.
synergy.FRO: Cheaper scouting in Spain and Iberian players within reach.
synergy.TER: Fewer injuries, cheaper medical staff and pre-season camps.
synergy.EMI: August brings donations and bigger crowds; members abroad.
synergy.DOR: Many residents but little identity; some fans follow bigger clubs.
synergy.ENE: A council with more budget and energy-company sponsors.
synergy.SER: High-value sponsors, but plenty of competition for attention.
synergy.MUL: Informal scouting network in Portuguese-speaking countries and diverse young talent.
synergy.ILH: Much costlier trips (flights) and Regional Government support.
